title: Performance Guarantee Exhibit, PBM Services Agreement
content:
Northbridge Rx guarantees three service levels to every plan sponsor holding a PBM Services Agreement: the average speed to answer member service calls, claims financial accuracy, and the turnaround to dispense clean home delivery prescriptions. Each guarantee has a credit amount, in USD, payable to the sponsor for missing it in a contract year, and each arrangement fixes how many calendar days after the contract year ends such credits are issued.

## Guaranteed service levels

| Pricing arrangement | Average speed to answer (seconds) | Claims financial accuracy | Home delivery turnaround (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 30 | 99.5% | 3 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 30 | 99.5% | 3 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 30 | 99.7% | 2 |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 25 | 99.8% | 2 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 20 | 99.9% | 2 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 20 | 99.9% | 2 |

## Credits for a missed guarantee in a contract year (USD)

| Pricing arrangement | Speed to answer missed | Claims accuracy missed | Home delivery turnaround missed | Credits issued within (calendar days after contract year end) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 90 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 2500.00 | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 90 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 90 |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 7500.00 | 7500.00 | 5000.00 | 60 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 7500.00 | 60 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 10000.00 | 15000.00 | 10000.00 | 60 |

## Explanatory notes

1. The speed-to-answer figure is the guaranteed average speed to answer on member service calls, in seconds.
2. The accuracy figure is the guaranteed claims financial accuracy, a share of claims expressed here as a percentage.
3. The turnaround figure is counted in business days and concerns clean home delivery prescriptions.
4. Each credit amount belongs to one guarantee and one contract year; the three guarantees carry separate amounts.
5. Under Northbridge Coalition Purchasing the claims accuracy credit (15000.00) is the largest amount in the exhibit; under Northbridge Traditional Pricing all three credits are 2500.00.
